methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series B → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.9x) to $500M last post money.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 3 same-sector + same/adjacent-stage peers in Climate & Energy. Range: $700M - $3.0B.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
Pano AI is a Series B climate and energy technology company that has raised $89M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 9 private frontier-tech companies and 1 public company (Lionanz, LNZA) operating in the same sector, including peers such as KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, Amogy, and Redwood Materials.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B advancement to the company's last known post-money valuation of $500M, yielding $950M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (KoBold Metals at $3.0B, Electric Hydrogen at $1.0B, and Amogy at $700M) produces a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $700M to $3.0B. The peer set reflects significant dispersion, reflecting heterogeneous technology maturity and commercial trajectory within the climate tech sector.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $808M to $1.1B, with a median of $975M. This range is anchored by stage-progression methodologies at the lower bound and peer comparables at the upper bound. Key uncertainties include the wide valuation dispersion among climate-tech peers, technology-specific commercialization timelines, and the early-stage nature of the comparable set, which limits predictive power for exit valuation.
